title: The Enigmatic Moai Statues of Easter Island

scenes.text: 900 giant moai statues were built by the early Rapa Nui people
The statues are up to 30 feet tall and weigh over 80 tons
The moai statues are considered some of the most impressive and mysterious ancient monuments in the world
But how did the early Rapa Nui people manage to build and move such massive statues without modern technology?
